principle: Prefer the smallest surface that does the job: an INI or framework config before a plugin record, a plugin record before a script, a script before a native F4SE plugin. Never edit Fallout4.esm, DLC masters or the game folder directly.
always: f4forge doctor first; it names the tier (Creation Kit or not) and what is missing
f4forge knowledge <topic> for the rules before writing anything
f4forge check before package; f4forge deploy is a dry run until --approve

tool_tiers.creation-kit: used when the Creation Kit is installed (default there)
tool_tiers.no-creation-kit: used when the Creation Kit is absent (and in CI)
tool_tiers.optional: improves the route; its absence is a named gap, never a failure

routes.title: Add or change plugin records (items, globals, keywords, overrides)
avoid: editing Fallout4.esm or a DLC master
new FormIDs outside the light-plugin range in an ESL-flagged plugin
hand-editing the binary plugin: the Spriggit YAML tree in plugin/ is the source of truth

routes.title: Add items or actors to leveled lists
avoid: overriding a vanilla leveled list in a plugin when a runtime injection does the job (overrides conflict with every other list mod)

routes.title: Write and compile Papyrus scripts
avoid: shipping .psc outside Scripts/Source
polling with RegisterForUpdate when an event exists
compiling into the game folder: output goes to the project's data/Scripts

routes.title: Quests, dialogue, scenes and companions
avoid: editing vanilla quest stages in place when a new quest with its own aliases works

routes.title: Mod Configuration Menu (MCM) settings page
avoid: writing to Data/MCM/Settings from the mod: MCM owns user settings
a config.json that fails the validator

routes.title: Runtime record patches with RobCo Patcher
avoid: using a key the validator marks unknown without reading its tier

routes.title: Swap base objects with Base Object Swapper
avoid: editing every placed reference in a plugin when a swap rule does it at load

routes.title: Native F4SE plugin (CommonLibF4)
avoid: hard-coded offsets: use Address Library IDs
shipping a DLL without its source (CommonLibF4 is GPL-3.0 with a modding exception)
assuming one DLL loads on every runtime generation

routes.title: Textures (DDS)
avoid: non-power-of-two sizes
textures without mips
BC7 where the vanilla role uses another format without a reason

routes.title: Materials (BGSM / BGEM)
avoid: pointing a material at a texture path the package does not ship or the game does not have

routes.title: Meshes (NIF)
avoid: installing PyNifly into Blender: the forge loads it by path
absolute texture or material paths inside a NIF

routes.title: BodySlide / Outfit Studio outfit conversion
avoid: shipping built meshes from someone else's body without its permissions

routes.title: LooksMenu presets
avoid: presets that reference overlays or sliders the mod does not list as requirements

routes.title: Audio and voice (WAV, XWM, LIP, FUZ)
routes.gap_without_creation_kit: XWM and LIP need the Creation Kit's xwmaencode and LipGenerator; without them audio is limited to FUZ pack/unpack and WAV checks
avoid: voice files outside Sound/Voice/<Plugin>/<VoiceType>/
WAV that is not 16-bit PCM mono at the expected rate

routes.title: Workshop and settlement objects
avoid: editing the vanilla workshop menu FLSTs directly: inject through a framework or a new menu keyword

routes.title: Weapons and weapon mods (OMOD)
avoid: changing a vanilla OMOD that other weapon mods also override when a new OMOD works

routes.title: Armor and clothing
avoid: biped slots that clash with common body or accessory slots without saying so on the mod page

routes.title: Precombines and previs
routes.gap_without_creation_kit: precombine and previs generation need the Creation Kit; without it the route reports the broken cells only
avoid: editing cells that carry precombined geometry without regenerating previs
running a Creation Kit generation without reviewing the dry run

routes.title: Interface (SWF menus and HUD)
routes.gap: 0.1 ships knowledge only for interface work (D15): no SWF writer or validator
avoid: replacing a vanilla SWF wholesale when a HUD framework widget works

routes.title: Animation (HKX, behaviors, AAF)
routes.gap: 0.1 ships knowledge only for animation (D15): no HKX writer or validator
avoid: editing vanilla behavior graphs without a fallback

routes.title: INI tweaks and game settings
avoid: writing into the user's Fallout4.ini or Fallout4Prefs.ini: ship a tweak file or a plugin INI instead

routes.title: Crash and log triage
avoid: changing several mods at once: roll back, then isolate the smallest change

routes.title: Conflicts and load order
avoid: sorting the user's load order without being asked

routes.title: Package and publish a mod
avoid: shipping STATE.md, PLAN.md, logs, script sources outside Scripts/Source or absolute paths
